description: Measured grid uncertainty of the Rust Kohn-Sham solver (Revision/kohn_sham/solver) for the states of the reference subset: |canonical - refined| of `revision_ks_solver single` (canonical: RK4 G = 900, root tolerance 1e-13, SCF tolerance 1e-11; refined: G = 1800, 1e-14, 1e-12), with the label-set margin of the canonical matrix. The canonical single run reproduces the committed canonical matrix (canonical_single_vs_matrix).
